title: Bolas Criollas
tagline: Aim the ring, time the swing, finish nearest the mingo.
description: The sand-court throwing game of Venezuela. Roll, lob or shoot heavy balls at the little white mingo on a cancha of loose and packed sand, time your release in the green, and outplay five rivals or a friend.
howToPlay: Touch the cancha to place the aim ring where the ball should land.
Hold SWING and let go while the needle is in the green.
Closest ball to the mingo scores for each ball that beats the rival's best.
